Boss 001.Name: Wall Watcher
Boss 001.Description: A Strange figment of your imagination, wanders around the edges of the dreamscape shooting aimlessly.

Boss 002.Name: Deep Watcher
Boss 002.recollectionDescription: Found deep in the depths of your psyche. Can manifest explosions all over the dreamscape!

Boss 003.Name: Growing Sorrows
Boss 003.recollectionDescription: This boss grows in sadness as the fight goes on.

Boss 004.Name: Soaring Sorrows
Boss 004.recollectionDescription: Feeds off the sorrow of others. Capable of using advanced attacks.

Boss 005.Name: Thought Cloud
Boss 005.recollectionDescription: Your thoughts and dreams in the form of a crying rain cloud.

Boss 006.Name: Infatuation Cloud
Boss 006.recollectionDescription: Thoughts of lust forming together to make strange weather patterns.

Boss 007.Name: Storm Cloud
Boss 007.recollectionDescription: These dark thoughts start to cloud your judgement.

Boss 008.Name: Nightmare Cloud
Boss 008.recollectionDescription: Storm of evil, uses immensely powerful rain attacks and can spawn more nightmare clouds.

Boss 009.Name: Jello Amorphous
Boss 009.recollectionDescription: Big Slime jumps around and spawns more jello.

Boss 010.Name: Agony Amorphous
Boss 010.recollectionDescription: This foe seems distressed at the sight of you. Existence is pain and it will try to spread some of that pain to you.

Boss 011.Name: Amorphous Prime
Boss 011.recollectionDescription: The apex of slime based bosses, both powerful and agile.

Boss 012.Name: Hand of the Accuser
Boss 012.recollectionDescription: Points and shoots at those accused.

Boss 013.Name: Cursed Clappers
Boss 013.recollectionDescription: Pair of hands that move fast and use powerful applause to damage the soul.

Boss 014.Name: Spooked Spirit
Boss 014.recollectionDescription: This spirit is scared, causing it to shoot unpredictable bad energy at you.

Boss 015.Name: Wicked Spectre
Boss 015.recollectionDescription: Strong and Dangerous apparition that has complete control over all of its projectiles!

Boss 016.Name: Horror Stack
Boss 016.recollectionDescription: These three bosses combine into one menace.

Boss 017.Name: Twister Devil
Boss 017.recollectionDescription: Chaotic Demon, capable of using the power of wind and tornadoes to aid in its unpredictable attacks!

Boss 018.Name: Fire Starter
Boss 018.recollectionDescription: Powerful spirit, likes to start fires and shoot a lot of accelerating shots.

Boss 019.Name: The Ghoul of Gestures
Boss 019.recollectionDescription: Has three Guardian hands orbiting it and is capable of shooting from all three of them.

Boss 020.Name: Manifest Spire
Boss 020.recollectionDescription: Strange construct that can manifest all kinds of other figures.

Boss 022.Name: Guardian
Boss 022.recollectionDescription: All Knowing boss uses orbs of pure recollection to attack the soul.

Boss 023.Name: Heart Ache
Boss 023.recollectionDescription: This heart aches in pain and horror. Splits into smaller versions of itself.

Boss 024.Name: Ninja Spirit
Boss 024.recollectionDescription: Throws shurikens at the soul, which can home in and cause trouble.

Boss 025.Name: Wisper
Boss 025.recollectionDescription: Silent Threat, can ditch its corporeal form and split into two equally dangerous spirits.

Boss 026.Name: Manic Wall Mage
Boss 026.recollectionDescription: Armed in the magic craft of making walls of bullets!

Boss 027.Name: Crazy Eyes
Boss 027.recollectionDescription: Pair of Erratic and Unpredicatable Bosses that see all.

Boss 028.Name: Phase Crawler
Boss 028.recollectionDescription: Crawls through dimensions. Spawns portals that release intricate bullet patterns.

Boss 029.Name: Barrier Demon
Boss 029.recollectionDescription: Creates barriers between individuals. Has several attacks that render entire portions of the dreamscape inhospitable.

Boss 030.Name: Behemoth
Boss 030.recollectionDescription: Massive beast found deep within dreams. Releases an onslaught of bullets from its limitless supply of heads.

Boss 031.Name: Sleeper x Manifestation
Boss 031.recollectionDescription: Sleeper creates a dream that can manifest itself in a variety of ways.

Boss 032.Name: Animated Head
Boss 032.recollectionDescription: Reanimated boss, uses the powers of pestilence to create trailing bullets.

Boss 033.Name: Chaotic Unrest
Boss 033.recollectionDescription: Deadly spirit unable to rest, its soul lingers in this skull. Shoots chaotic magic and can create additional chaos spirits.

Boss 034.Name: Locust
Boss 034.recollectionDescription: Bringer of plagues and famine. Creates several clones of itself that cause havoc all over the field.

Boss 035.Name: Grim Apparition
Boss 035.recollectionDescription: Instills you with a grim feeling. Malicous apparition that channels bursts of dark energy.

Boss 036.Name: Dream Invader
Boss 036.recollectionDescription: Arbiter of invasive thoughts. Can produce tractor beams and stun the soul with advanced techniques. Also has the power to summon meteorites.

Boss 037.Name: Jackhamster
Boss 037.recollectionDescription: Pogo stick master, can perform several maneuvers in the air to shower the field in bullets.

Boss 038.Name: Crush
Boss 038.recollectionDescription: Love hurts, this foe is capable of swinging a large bullet flail that makes the entire field dangerous.

Boss 039.Name: Migraine
Boss 039.recollectionDescription: Headache inducing boss. Imagines complex bullet patterns and materializes them instantly.

Boss 040.Name: Demonic Villainy
Boss 040.recollectionDescription: Evil doer that unleashes pain in a variety of ways.

Boss 042.Name: Pocket
Boss 042.recollectionDescription: Sentient pocket dimension, drops bullets across the dreamscape. Can possess inanimate objects and summon more opponents.

Boss 043.Name: Gutter Ball
Boss 043.recollectionDescription: Rolls around the field chasing after the soul. Can perform high scoring attacks.

Boss 044.Name: Conga Line
Boss 044.recollectionDescription: They move in formation and attack with coordination.

Boss 045.Name: Tough Luck
Boss 045.recollectionDescription: 6-Sided Boss, each side has unique attack patterns. Rerolls itself every phase.

Boss 046.Name: Soul Collector
Boss 046.recollectionDescription: Collection of lost souls trapped in the ooze. Stationary opponent that releases massive amounts of bullets.

Boss 047.Name: Twin Horrors
Boss 047.recollectionDescription: A pair of horrific bosses that get scarier when released.

Boss 048.Name: Danger Raiser
Boss 048.recollectionDescription: Sprouts various methods of harming the soul. Has masterful control of bullet movements.

Boss 049.Name: Mind Corruptor
Boss 049.recollectionDescription: Immensely powerful boss that can render large portions of the field inhospitable.

Boss 050.Name: Wall of Thoughts
Boss 050.recollectionDescription: Huge formation of thoughts that attacks the soul with painful rain memories.

Boss 056.Name: Dream Crawler
Boss 056.recollectionDescription: These crawl around feeding off of dreams. Unleashes a barrage of bullets with its many eyes.

Boss 057.Name: Boxer
Boss 057.recollectionDescription: Dreamscape resident puppet. Attacks with a wacky box of tricks.

Boss 064.Name: Puck
Boss 064.recollectionDescription: Weird and unpredictable boss that can shoot looping projectiles.

Boss 065.Name: Mass Puck
Boss 065.recollectionDescription: Distorted Boss that shoots looping projectiles all over the place.

Boss 081.Name: Snake Eyes
Boss 081.recollectionDescription: Slithery Menace, attacks the soul with exotic bullet patterns.

Boss 082.Name: King of Beasts
Boss 082.recollectionDescription: Savage beast, viciously attacks the soul with bite styled moves.

Boss 083.Name: The Construct
Boss 083.recollectionDescription: Mechanical Construct, piloted by a wicked soul. Flies and attacks with precisely engineered attacks.

Boss 084.Name: Brainwash
Boss 084.recollectionDescription: Cleanses the dreamscape of your presence. Soapy boss that moves erratically and leaves a slippery path behind

Boss 086.Name: Bed Bugs
Boss 086.recollectionDescription: Spikey Fiend, jumps around and spawns swarms of bed bugs to terrorize the soul.

Boss 087.Name: Dungeon Executioner
Boss 087.recollectionDescription: Powerful knight. Uses it's axe to deal punishment with quick moves.

Boss 089.Name: Sleep Caster
Boss 089.recollectionDescription: Trickey Spellcaster. Uses spells to make the soul fall alseep, and create strange bullet patterns.

Boss 090.Name: Head In The Clouds
Boss 090.recollectionDescription: Flying angel head. Summons deadly attacks directly from the inside of its head.
